Hi Emily / Raj —

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate the candid overview of Stellar Labs' current inference bottlenecks. Quick recap from our side and a couple of proposed next steps so the team can decide whether this is worth a short technical follow-up.

Call highlights
- Current pain: inconsistent latency and high per-token cost on Production transformer endpoints (esp. batch tails).
- Constraints: cannot change upstream inference library, must stay within EKS-managed infra for now.
- Success metric: reduce 95th pct latency by ~30% while keeping model quality within 2% of current baseline.

What we recommended on the call
- 2-step path: (1) 30-min technical sync to validate request SLAs & infra constraints, (2) 4-week pilot on a small traffic slice with batching + KV-prefix caching.
- Expected outcome: measurable latency improvement and a unit-cost projection — see attached ballpark-costs.xlsx for an early estimate.

Open questions for you (quick answers appreciated)
1) Priority — where does this sit on your roadmap for Q1? (High / Medium / Low)
2) Data sensitivity — any special compliance requirements beyond standard SOC2?
3) Pilot scope — could you commit ~10% of traffic for a short pilot?

Proposed next steps
- If this is still a priority: 30-min tech sync with our Solutions Engineer (Grace) — slots we have next week: Tue 12/1 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 12/2 14:00–15:00 PT, Thu 12/3 09:00–10:00 PT.
- If you prefer, we can also record a short demo showing the batching/caching behavior on your model class.

If this isn't a current priority, totally understand — a one-line reply (High/Medium/Low) would help us close the loop.

Appreciate it —
